text: dsh-message-rewind 是 DeepSeek Harness 网页端插件，在用户消息气泡下提供编辑、删除和复制操作，并通过主机接口截断后续对话。编辑后会从修改内容重新发送，删除则移除该消息及后续轮次；两种操作都可选择把已记录的文本文件改动恢复到消息之前。适合需要修正提示或撤回对话、并管理关联文件状态的 DSH 用户。需要 Node.js 20+ 和兼容版本的 DSH，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-message-rewind is a DSH web plugin for editing or deleting your sent messages. Editing resends corrected text from that point; deletion removes later turns. Either action can optionally restore recorded text-file changes. It requires Node.js 20+ and a compatible DSH version, with no API key.
我想把刚发出去的提示词改一下，然后从新内容继续对话。
怎么删掉一条消息以及它后面的所有轮次？
希望撤回对话时，也能把这一段之后改过的文本文件还原。
DSH 发错内容后，有没有办法直接从那条消息重新开始？
我想在网页聊天记录里复制自己的消息，顺手修订或删除它。
能不能只回滚聊天内容，或者连相关文件变化一起撤销？
Can I revise a sent prompt and continue the conversation from the corrected text?
I need to remove one message and every conversation turn that came after it.
dsh-message-rewind 的功能「编辑并重发」：在自己的消息旁打开编辑框，修改纯文本后保存；插件截断该消息之后的轮次，并把新内容作为后续对话重新发送。
dsh-message-rewind 的功能「删除后续对话」：从自己的消息菜单确认删除，所选消息及其后的会话内容会被截断，随后打开截断后的会话分支。
dsh-message-rewind 的功能「可选恢复文件」：执行编辑或删除时，可选择连同消息之后记录的文件改动一起恢复；恢复过程仅针对记录的文本文件差异。
dsh-message-rewind 的功能「消息复制」：在自己的消息气泡旁使用复制按钮，将消息文本写入剪贴板，并显示短暂的已复制状态。
dsh-message-rewind 使用前须知：含附件的消息不能编辑，且文件回滚依赖可用的记录快照，仅支持文本文件；没有工作区或快照不完整时只能回滚消息。

dsh-message-rewind README · dsh-message-rewind：**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的消息气泡加两个按钮：**编辑**和**删除**。

- 发错字了？改一下，直接从改后的内容重新开始，不用重开对话。
- 说话越界了？删掉这条，它之后的所有对话一起消失。
- 那一轮还改过文件？可以顺手把文件也还原到这条消息之前的样子。

> A DSH plugin that adds **edit** and **delete** to your own message bubbles. Deleting truncates every following turn and can optionally roll the recorded file changes back.

---

dsh-message-rewind README · 它能做什么：| 你想要的 | 插件怎么帮你 |
| --- | --- |
| 改掉已发送的消息 | 点消息气泡下方的铅笔，改完点「保存并重发」，这条消息之后的内容会被截断，然后按你改后的内容重新开始 |
| 撤掉一条越界的消息 | 点垃圾桶，确认后这条消息连同它之后的所有对话一起删除 |
| 连文件一起还原 | 删除/编辑时，如果那一轮动过文件，按钮下方的小窗会让你选「只回滚消息」还是「连文件一起回滚」 |
| 不打扰正在跑的任务 | 有未结束的轮次时直接拒绝操作，不会和正在执行的 turn 抢写 |

只有你自己发出的消息才有这两个按钮；「复制」按钮仍在，位置不变。
dsh-message-rewind README · 界面：自己发出的消息，气泡下方会多出「编辑 / 删除 / 复制」三个按钮： 点铅笔或垃圾桶之后，小窗直接出现在那个按钮正下方，并用一个小箭头指向它；点窗外或按 Esc 就收起。编辑窗一打开就会读出这条消息之后记录到的文件改动，默认只显示一行「已记录 N 处文件改动」，展开才看具体路径；要不要连文件一起还原，用一个二选一的开关决定：

dsh-message-rewind README · 界面：| 靠近底部时翻到上方 | 窄屏（390px） | 亮色主题 | | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | |
dsh-message-rewind README · 界面：快照失效、工作区不在 Git 仓库等限制也会直接标在小窗里，不用等到操作失败才知道。
dsh-message-rewind README · 安装：需要 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 及以上（0.2.x），Node.js ≥ 20；已在 0.2.2-rc.1 上验证。宿主启动时会按 `engines.dsh` 校验，低于该版本会拒绝加载。

dsh-message-rewind README · 从 npm 安装（推荐）：包已发布到 npm：[dsh-message-rewind](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-message-rewind)，也在[插件市场](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/xCube007/dsh-message-rewind/)里。

最省事的一条命令：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-message-rewind
```

也可以直接在 DSH 里装：**设置 → 插件 → 搜索 `dsh-message-rewind`**。

习惯自己改配置的话，手动安装等价于下面三步：

1. 在 profile 的 `package.json`（`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`）里加依赖：

```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "dsh-message-rewind": "^1.2.0"
     }

dsh-message-rewind README · 从 npm 安装（推荐）：2. 在同一个 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里挂上插件：

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: message-rewind
         name: 'dsh-message-rewind'
   ```

3. 在该 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`，然后重启 DSH（或在「设置 → 插件」里启用）。

dsh-message-rewind README · 从源码安装（想改代码时用）：```bash
git clone https://github.com/xCube007/dsh-message-rewind.git D:/Code/dsh-message-rewind
```

依赖写成链接形式，其余步骤相同：

```json
"dsh-message-rewind": "link:D:/Code/dsh-message-rewind"
```

text: dsh-message-rewind README · 装好之后：DSH 启动日志里会出现 `message-rewind` 且状态为 active；刷新页面，你自己消息的气泡下方就会多出「编辑 / 删除 / 复制」三个按钮。

dsh-message-rewind README · 使用：1. 点铅笔 → 按钮下方弹出小窗，改完点「保存并重发」。
2. 点垃圾桶 → 点「删除」，删除这条消息及其后的全部对话。
3. 小窗打开时就会读取这条消息之后记录到的文件改动：默认折叠成一行「已记录 N 处文件改动」，点开可看路径；有改动时还会多出一个二选一的回滚范围：
   - **只回滚消息**（默认）：文件保持现状；
   - **连文件一起回滚**：文件恢复成这条消息之前的内容；
   - 选好范围后，点「保存并重发」或「删除」执行。

快照失效、还有排队中的消息、工作区不在 Git 仓库等情况会在小窗里用一行提示说明。

dsh-message-rewind README · 文件回滚：什么能回、什么回不了：**能回**：文本文件的新建、修改、删除——包括同一轮里「先新建再删掉」这类组合。

**回不了时会直接报错，不会静默跳过**：

| 情况 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 二进制文件 | 无法回滚（只记录了文本 diff） |
| 工作区不在 Git 仓库内，且文件是被 shell 命令改的 | 无法记录，因而无法回滚；在该目录 `git init` 后可完整记录 |
| 会话重启或释放后，早先的快照已过期 | 提示「部分改动快照已不可用」，此时只能只回滚消息 |
| 文件在记录之后又被你（或别的工具）改过 | 回滚会被**拒绝**，不会覆盖掉你后来的改动 |
| 这个会话没有工作区 | 只能只回滚消息 |
section: 文件回滚：什么能回、什么回不了

text:
dsh-message-rewind README · 常见问题：**Q：回滚之后，侧边栏是不是会多出一条对话？**
不会，始终只有一条同名对话。但底层会话 ID 会变：DSH 的会话日志是只追加的，没有「删掉中间一段」的接口，插件只能 fork 出一个截断后的分支，再把原会话移出侧边栏并删除其日志目录。所以如果你在别处引用过这个会话 ID，需要重新取一次。

**Q：原会话的记录还能找回吗？**
正常情况下会被删除。只有当日志目录被占用删不掉时，原会话会保留在归档里。

**Q：为什么带附件的消息不能编辑？**
附件是作为消息内容的一部分存下来的，编辑只支持纯文本消息。带附件的消息可以删除。

**Q：点按钮提示「当前有未结束的轮次」？**
先停止正在运行的任务再操作。另外，如果有排队中的消息，它们会随被删除的记录一起作废——小窗里会提示。

**Q：看不到按钮？**
确认插件已在「设置 → 插件」里启用、并且刷新过一次页面；另外只有你自己发的消息才有这两个按钮。

dsh-message-rewind README · dsh-message-rewind：[简体中文](README.md) | **English**

Edit and delete your own messages in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

- Typo in a sent prompt? Fix it, and the conversation continues from the edited text — no need to start over.
- Said something you regret? Delete that message and every turn after it disappears with it.
- Files changed during that turn? Optionally roll them back to the state before the message.

---

dsh-message-rewind README · What it does：| You want to | What the plugin does |
| --- | --- |
| Change a sent message | Click the pencil under your bubble, edit the text, then click **Save and resend**. Everything after that message is truncated and the conversation restarts from your edited text. |
| Drop an out-of-line message | Click the trash icon and confirm. That message and every following turn are deleted. |
| Restore files too | When deleting or editing, if that turn recorded file changes, the popover lets you choose **messages only** or **messages and files**. |
| Stay out of a running task | The action is refused while a turn is still running, so it never races the agent's writes. |
dsh-message-rewind README · What it does：Only messages you sent have these buttons. The **Copy** button is still there, in the same position.
dsh-message-rewind README · Screenshots：Your own messages get **edit / delete / copy** buttons under the bubble:

dsh-message-rewind README · Screenshots：The popover opens right under the button you clicked and points at it with a small arrow; click outside or press Esc to dismiss it. The editor reads the file changes recorded after that message as soon as it opens — collapsed into one **N file changes recorded** line unless you expand it — and a two-way switch decides whether files are restored too:

dsh-message-rewind README · Screenshots：The popover follows its button: it flips above when there is no room below, narrows to the screen width on small viewports, and keeps the same layering in the light theme:

dsh-message-rewind README · Screenshots：Snapshot and Git-worktree limits are shown in the popover itself, not after a failed operation.

dsh-message-rewind README · Install：Requires DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or newer (0.2.x) and Node.js ≥ 20; verified on 0.2.2-rc.1. DSH validates `engines.dsh` at startup and refuses to load the plugin on an older host.

dsh-message-rewind README · From npm (recommended)：Published on npm as [dsh-message-rewind](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-message-rewind), and listed in the [plugin market](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/xCube007/dsh-message-rewind/).

One command:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-message-rewind
```

Or install from inside DSH: **Settings → Plugins → search `dsh-message-rewind`**.

If you prefer editing the profile yourself, the manual route is the same three steps:

dsh-message-rewind README · From npm (recommended)：1. Add the dependency to your profile's `package.json` (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`):

```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "dsh-message-rewind": "^1.2.0"
     }

2. Register the plugin in the same profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: message-rewind
         name: 'dsh-message-rewind'
   ```

3. Run `pnpm install` in that profile directory, then restart DSH (or enable it under **Settings → Plugins**).

dsh-message-rewind README · From source (if you want to change the code)：```bash
git clone https://github.com/xCube007/dsh-message-rewind.git D:/Code/dsh-message-rewind
```

Use a link dependency; the remaining steps are the same:

```json
"dsh-message-rewind": "link:D:/Code/dsh-message-rewind"
```

text: dsh-message-rewind README · After installing：The DSH startup log lists `message-rewind` as active. Refresh the page and your own message bubbles get **edit / delete / copy** buttons.
dsh-message-rewind README · Usage：Lost snapshots, queued prompts, and non-Git workspaces are called out in one-line notes inside the popover.

dsh-message-rewind README · File rollback: what can and cannot be restored：**Can be restored:** creating, modifying, and deleting text files — including combinations within one turn, such as "create then delete".

**When it cannot, the plugin fails loudly instead of skipping silently:**
section: File rollback: what can and cannot be restored

text:
dsh-message-rewind README · File rollback: what can and cannot be restored：| Situation | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Binary file | Cannot be restored (only text diffs are recorded) |
| Workspace is not a Git repository and the file was changed by a shell command | Not recorded, so it cannot be restored. Run `git init` in that directory to record everything. |
| Session restarted or released, so earlier snapshots expired | You are told some snapshots are unavailable; messages-only rollback still works |
| The file was changed again after being recorded (by you or another tool) | Rollback is **refused** rather than overwriting your later changes |
| The conversation has no workspace | Messages-only rollback |
section: File rollback: what can and cannot be restored

text:
dsh-message-rewind README · FAQ：**Q: Does the sidebar get an extra conversation after a rollback?**
No — there is always just one conversation with the same name. The underlying session ID does change, though: DSH session logs are append-only and have no "delete a middle chunk" API, so the plugin forks a truncated branch, archives the original out of the sidebar, and deletes its log directory. If you referenced that session ID elsewhere, fetch it again.

dsh-message-rewind README · FAQ：**Q: Can the original record be recovered?**
Normally it is deleted. Only when its log directory is still held open and cannot be removed does the original stay in the archive.

**Q: Why can't messages with attachments be edited?**
Attachments are stored as part of the message content, and editing only supports plain-text messages. Messages with attachments can still be deleted.

dsh-message-rewind README · FAQ：**Q: The button says a turn is still running?**
Stop the running task first. Also note that queued prompts are discarded together with the deleted record — the popover warns you about this.

**Q: I don't see the buttons.**
Check that the plugin is enabled under **Settings → Plugins** and that you refreshed the page. Only messages you sent have these buttons.

dsh-message-rewind README · Uninstall：Remove the `dsh-message-rewind` dependency from your profile's `package.json`, delete the matching `insert` entry from `cordis.patch.yml`, run `pnpm install`, and restart DSH.
